LEAD DISPOSITION: ACCEPT this amendment. B0-C will own only the versioned normative repair specification plus project-authored synthetic input/expected-output oracle and content digests. C1 will own the executable provider-free coordinate/mapping/result/receipt ADTs and JVM/JS/Native law courts. D0 alone will parse admitted Sherlock records, apply the frozen rule, and emit the realized diagnostic atlas and repair receipt.

I also accept the five-way distinction among absent legacy timing, explicit empty AudioSpan, native packet duration unknown, mapping gap/no-correspondence, and unlawful conversion refusal. The eventual B0 decision will incorporate the run-identity, non-bridging discontinuity, occurrence-scoped reverse, and receipt-discrimination courts named here.

This sharpens the decomposition without changing its admission boundary or authorizing C1/D0 work.
